text:
owen: Heads-up — we're running a short 'infra-stress' rehearsal Tue 23:00-23:30 UTC to validate SLO guarding and the new soft-throttle layer. Will simulate sustained CPU pressure on a small prod shard and verify routing+autoscale responses.

 talia: Which shard and will reserved Dedicated capacity be affected?

 owen: shard-21. Reserved Dedicated pools are excluded. We'll use targeting rules to shift 10% traffic to fallback pools. Non-prod pools will be drained for a full-path test.

 sam: Alerting plan? I want to avoid noisy pages.

 owen: Plan: silence latency-noise 15m before start, keep error-rate pages active. Temporarily set p99 page to 8s for the window and enable a 'testing-only' p99 4s/1m alert that logs but doesn't page.

 infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: infra-stress rehearsal in 24h. Notifying on-call.

 talia: Runbook link? Need to check kv prefill and soft-throttle thresholds.

 owen: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rehearsals/infra-stress-2111. Key commands in runbook for soft-throttle: 

 infractl feature-flag set soft_throttle.enabled true --scope=shard-21
 infractl throttle update --shard=shard-21 --p99_threshold=0.9 --backoff=15s

 sam: Rollback steps?

 owen: Flip soft_throttle.enabled false and revert routing.policy to stable. Commands in runbook. We'll run a 2m canary at 23:05 then full 20m test if metrics ok.

 talia: I'll confirm there are no overlapping infra maints. Also tagging long eval jobs exclude-from-rehearsal.

 sam: ack. I'll run smoke tests pre/post and post p95/p99 and error-rate in this thread.

 owen: Oncall: sam primary, talia backup. Please ack if no blockers.

 talia: ack :thumbsup:

 sam: ack

 sre-bot: Thread pinned to channel by owen.
